arc: Nine ring/tablet states trace nihilism's arrival, anatomy, nadir, and turn inside one gouge grammar: sealed tablet hairline-cracked (prophecy), ring nearly whole with one gap and one escaping sulphur chip (the guest), ring split into three staggered arcs (purpose/unity/being), ring wreathed in five fumes (intoxications), ring inverted with one quarantined blighted segment (décadence), ring opened widest and gauge-ticked with a bone witness staff (recurrence), ring barely pressed on cracked ice with NO sulphur (nadir), one ring in three century-details (gallery), ring broken open with a sulphur arc-end rising past the rule (strength). Sulphur rationing carries the accent-arc: present as a point or band-segment, absent only at p2c6, largest (still a band, never a field, per ArtDirector W2) at p2c8. A title swap onto any other book must feel wrong because every fracture-state depicts a sentence actually present in its chapter.

p1c1.content_rationale: The preface announces the whole book as prophecy: culture 'like a torrent, restlessly, violently rushing to its end,' the 'music of the future,' the writer as 'instinctive hermit' and 'bird of augury' who 'foretells what is to come,' and the revaluation formula as 'a contrary movement' and 'gospel of the future.' Within the sealed-tablet grammar the tablet is the gospel before it is opened: five incised stave-lines (music of the future, still unbroken), a hairline crack starting at one corner (the torrent to come), one sulphur seal-dot at the crack's origin (the revaluation). No figure: the hermit is a voice, not a portrait.
p1c1.fleurons_note: 5-paragraph proclamation; no interior breaks. Identity suggests ~every 8th boundary: none fall here.

p2c1.content_rationale: The chapter opens with the cohort's primal image, 'Nihilism stands at the door; whence comes this most uncanny of all guests?', then catalogues its arrivals (morality's self-overthrow, science, politics, historiography, art) and closes the Copernican arc: 'Since Copernicus man has been rolling away from the centre towards x.' Within the broken-ring grammar the gap IS the door: a nearly whole ring with one narrow fracture facing the title, and a single sulphur chip escaping through it (the guest; the roll toward x). The guest is drawn as absence-plus-chip, never a face, because 'whence comes' is left unanswered.
p2c1.fleurons_note: After para 4 (close of the (2)/(3) morality-collapse block: 'Antagonisms arise between the true, the beautiful and the good') before para 5 (the (4) turn to science and Spinozism).

p2c2.content_rationale: The chapter's argument is structural: 'the highest values devalue themselves,' the 'antinomy' ('in so far as we believe in morality, we condemn existence'), and the final unavailability of the categories 'purpose, unity, being.' Nothing attacks from outside; the building fails from within. Within the ring grammar the ring itself stratifies: three arcs at staggered radii (the three categories crumbling at different rates), split by sulphur crack-gouges (the antinomy). No storm, no hammer, no enemy figure.
p2c2.fleurons_note: After 9 (the antinomy stated) before the 'supreme values' block; after 15 before the numbered 'Critique of nihilism'; after 23 ('no truth' presupposition) before 'A change in values'; after 29 ('divine way of thinking') before the disillusionment/Schopenhauer turn; after 33 (ideal 'smuggled in') before 'The most ubiquitous sign of modern times'; after 38 ('no confidence in the will') before 'The perfect nihilist'; after 45 (weakness) before 'The advent of nihilism'.

p2c3.content_rationale: The chapter is a list of ersatz escapes: 'intoxication of music,' 'cruel pleasure in the tragic ruin of the noblest,' 'blind enthusiasm,' 'mysticism, the voluptuous enjoyment of eternal emptiness,' art as 'a drug,' 'silly little fanaticism,' closing on 'the tragic age.' Plural small intoxications, none filling the room. Within the ring grammar the ring stays whole but its upper edge dissolves into five fume plumes gouged from the band itself: note-heads, flame tongues, hollow halo rings, tight smoke spirals, and one flat void-gap (eternal emptiness).
p2c3.fleurons_note: After 6 ('Emptiness') before the intoxication catalogue; after 16 (end of escape catalogue) before 'weakness of will'; after 19 ('pay for having been Christians') before 'words, words, words'; after 26 (end of the (a)-(g) clinging list) before 'European pessimism is still in its infancy'; after 30 before the 'reasons for pessimism' catalogue; after 34 before 'For a critique of pessimism'; after 39 before 'The development of nihilism from pessimism'; after 43 ('we arrive at nihilism') before the strength/weakness close and 'the tragic age'.

p2c4.content_rationale: The chapter's master move is inversion: 'pessimism is not a problem but a symptom,' 'what have been considered its causes are in fact its consequences,' the exhausted confounded with the richly endowed ('The exhausted are harmful'), exhausted men legislating values, and the one permitted response: 'quarantine' ('reduce the decadent man's deleterious influence to a minimum'). Within the ring grammar the ring is ROTATED 180 degrees (fracture at the bottom: the inversion made structural), one arc-segment blighted with heavy black gouge and ringed by a dashed sulphur quarantine arc. Nothing is cured; one segment is isolated.
p2c4.fleurons_note: After 11 (quarantine passage) before the numbered theses; after 17 (history-of-nihilism types) before 'On the hygiene of the weak'; after 26 ('Errors in treatment') before 'Religion as décadence'; after 33 (intoxication physiology) before the acquired-exhaustion catalogue; after 39 (exhaustion theory) before 'The will to power as morality'; after 45 (sociology) before the closing 'A Preface'; after 54 (teachings) before 'Virtue is our greatest misunderstanding' and the close.

p2c5.content_rationale: The crisis chapter states recurrence as hypothesis, not mysticism: 'the most scientific of all possible hypotheses,' 'the most extreme form of nihilism: nothingness for ever,' the strong as those who 'embrace a great deal of contingency and absurdity,' closing on the open question 'What would such a man think of the eternal recurrence?' Within the ring grammar this chapter shows the ring OPENED WIDEST and ticked like a gauge dial (the instrument of hypothesis); one bone tick elongates into a witness staff standing in the gap (the man who faces it). No serpent, no halo, no occult furniture.
p2c5.fleurons_note: After 3 (hypothesis stated: 'most scientific of all possible hypotheses') before the pantheism/affirmation problem; after 11 (unfortunates/disintegration diagnosis) before 'Who will prove to be the strongest'. The 12-14 close (strongest, question, periods-coda) runs unbroken.

p2c6.content_rationale: The gloom chapter's images are all of treading and thin surfaces: 'where we tread, soon no one will be able to follow,' 'the baleful breath of the warm, thawing wind,' 'sombre music,' 'an immense laboratory' of failed experiments, 'un monstre et un chaos.' Within the ring grammar the ring is BARELY PRESSED — the faintest violet impression, nearly vanished — while the plate field itself is crossed by radiating hairline cracks (thin ice). The print-maker is absent (no witness, no chip). This is the arc's nadir, so ALL sulphur is withdrawn from the art: the denial itself is the design statement.
p2c6.fleurons_note: After 1 (youth lament) before the modern-gloom catalogue; after 12 (catalogue end) before the NB herd passage; after 16 (herd/poor) before 'Critique of modern man'; after 20 before the 'exceedingly humane' movement; after 24 ('justification of history') before 'The second Buddhism'; after 30 (tradition/charade) before the moralities passage; after 38 (NB milieu) before the Modernity-as-nutrition passage; after 48 (parasites) before 'The Charade'; after 58 (charade catalogue) before the grand-words catalogue; after 66 (grand words) before 'Towards a critique of big words'; after 81 (Protestantism/German spirit) before the 'Progress'/laboratory finale. No fleuron adjacent to NB paras 13/45 (their margin-bars already break the rhythm).

p2c7.content_rationale: The chapter is a gallery: portraits of the 17th ('propre, exact et libre,' 'the century of strong will'), 18th ('dominated by woman,' Voltaire vs Rousseau, 'the fighting broke out around 1760'), and 19th centuries ('gloomier, more realistic, stronger'), plus the three-century formula (aristocratism/Descartes, feminism/Rousseau, animalism/Schopenhauer), Renaissance vs Reformation, Kant, Wagner, and Napoleon and Goethe as the two transcendences. Within the ring grammar the plate holds THREE RING DETAILS in a row — one ring in three centuries: a whole severe arc with one sulphur capital-tick (17th, aristocratism), an overthrown broken arc (18th), a low half-sunk arc (19th, subterranean). Sulphur rationed to the first detail alone.
p2c7.fleurons_note: After 4 (Kant/stragglers) before Renaissance and Reformation; after 11 (three-centuries formula) before the 17th-century portrait; after 14 (19th portrait) before Comte; after 24 (Enlightenment/sentimentality) before the 17th-vs-18th comparison sequence; after 33 (comparisons) before 'Against Rousseau'; after 48 (Rousseau sequence) before Kant epistemology; after 54 (NB strong-centuries + 19th-vs-18th) before the campagna catalogue; after 57 before 'Two great attempts' (Napoleon, Goethe); after 63 before the music preponderance; after 70 (Wagner culmination) before the Germans-becoming finale.

p2c8.content_rationale: The closing chapter turns the whole cohort: 'precisely the same symptoms might indicate either decline or strength,' 'great growth is always accompanied by tremendous fragmentation and destruction,' 'the reversal of the hierarchy,' 'the great noon,' barbarians and 'sovereign individuals,' and the terminal challenge 'How far does art reach down into the essence of strength?' Within the ring grammar the ring BREAKS OPEN into two arc-ends — one withering violet-black, one rising sulphur — and the rising end crosses ABOVE the opener's sulphur rule (the only art in the cohort permitted to cross the rule: the frame-break translated into the opener contract). A thin bone half-disc (great noon) stands behind the break.
p2c8.fleurons_note: After 8 (humanization) before 'The reversal of the hierarchy'; after 13 (senses) before 'We who are objective'; after 16 before 'The naturalization of man'; after 26 (summa) before the corruption/culture movement; after 38 (Socialism) before the remedies catalogue; after 44 before the strong-willed sequence; after 49 before 'Outwardly: tremendous wars'; after 54 (barbarians/sovereign individuals) before 'Good Europeans'; after 64 (Good Europeans) before 'The twentieth century'; after 67 (earthquake) before the numbered close. Para 0 is NB (own treatment); no fleuron at the head.

grammar_rules: Opener contract (5 layers, in order): mono part eyebrow ('BOOK <ROMAN> — <SUBTITLE>'), gouged plate-mark (~120px base; Part I ring large behind/above eyebrow), Fraunces chapter title clamp(2.2rem,5.5vw,3.6rem), sulphur rule with LIVE fragment-count inscription ('<N> FRAGMENTS · <W> WORDS' from data-paras + reader:chapter.detail), Fraunces 900 drop cap (standard chapters; yields to NB. marker at p2c8).

One medium: authored SVG gouge plates (knockout masks, torn edges, hatch). Part ink at ~85% + sulphur discipline. No gradients, no new media, no stock, no emoji. Per ArtDirector W1 the WtP gouge stays TORN and irregular (knockout-mask violence, visibly rougher than Sovereign intaglio/Churchill shards); if prototypes blur, WtP goes rougher, never cleaner.

Part 0 (p1c1): Faint Pencil + Bone, sealed-tablet motif, hushed centered opener, small plate, generous silence. Part I (p2c1-p2c8): Gloom Violet, broken-ring motif, heavy low opener, ring large behind/above eyebrow.

Sulphur is THE accent and is rationed across the arc: a point (p1c1, p2c1, p2c5 zero-tick), crack-gouges (p2c2), a quarantine dash (p2c4), a capital-tick (p2c7), WHOLLY ABSENT from the art at p2c6 (nadir), dominant only at p2c8 (turn). p2c3 withholds sulphur from fumes (false comforts emit no light).

Only p2c8 art crosses the opener rule (the rising sulphur arc-end). Every other plate stays behind/above the eyebrow and below the title. Sulphur obeys match logic (ArtDirector W2): small, hot, sparse applications only — never large glowing fields.

Fleurons: small sulphur '·' at the authored 0-based paragraph indices listed per chapter (rendered in the boundary AFTER the indexed paragraph), implemented from the authored list, NEVER modulo/nth-child generated. ~Every 8th boundary, snapped to genuine content seams.

NB. paragraphs: frozen p.reader-nb hook only (start-anchored). Sulphur left margin-bar + mono NB. marker, scoped by body[data-chapter]. Never recolor whole paragraphs. Mid-line NB. cases are awareness-only, unstyled.

Reading body is one calm system across all nine chapters: Newsreader, Bone on Inkblack, no art behind prose, no per-paragraph color. Part I body distinction: fragment numerals in Gloom Violet. (a)/(b) sub-notes: quiet indent.
Type roles are fenced: Fraunces displays/titles/drop caps/part lines; Newsreader prose/captions/TOC names; Plex Mono eyebrows/numerals/markers/inscriptions/meta. No other faces.
Motion budget: plates render static. At most one ≤900ms opener contour reveal, disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. No scroll-triggered animation in the reading body.

Banned from this cohort: cards, gradient washes, numeral badges, eyebrow labels above content other than the contract eyebrow, all-caps display outside tracked mono eyebrows, middle-dot meta strings (inscriptions use the contract's '·' separator ONLY inside the fragment-count inscription), appended arrows, modulo/hash tinting, fragment-URL manifest src.
